title: Feature-edge overlay should respect depth buffer
description:
The STAGES and CREST_VS_BOUNDARY shader modes draw their overlay edges with depth-test disabled, so edges on the far side of the mesh bleed through to the front. Makes the view look transparent/confusing when rotating — you can't tell which edges are actually on the surface you're looking at.

Root cause: HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.renderFeatureEdgeOverlay currently does:
```java
gl.disable(gl.DEPTH_TEST());
...
gl.enable(gl.DEPTH_TEST());
```
This was copied from renderEdges (wireframe mode) which also draws through. For the diagnostic overlays the user explicitly wants back-face-correct rendering.

Fix: leave depth test on, but apply a tiny camera-ward bias so lines don't z-fight with the faces they sit on. Options:
- glPolygonOffset with GL_POLYGON_OFFSET_LINE (if supported across our GL backends — check LWJGL desktop, WebGL via TeaVM).
- Vertex shader pushes line vertices slightly toward the camera in view-space before projection. Works universally. About 4 lines of GLSL in a new mesh_edge.vs or we extend mesh_unlit.vs with a uniform `depthBias`.
- GL_DEPTH_FUNC=LEQUAL plus per-frame glDepthRange tweak — hacky, skip.

Preferred: vertex-shader bias. Keeps all backends happy and doesn't touch the cross-platform abstraction.

Critical files:
- ixdar-app/src/main/java/ixdar/graphics/render/model/HalfEdgeMeshRuntime.java (renderFeatureEdgeOverlay, currently disables depth test).
- ixdar-app/src/main/resources/glsl/mesh_unlit.vs or a new mesh_edge.vs (if extending existing).

Not affected: renderEdges (wireframe mode) — it can stay depth-off since that's the user's explicit convention for wireframe.
definition-of-done:
1. In STAGES and CREST_VS_BOUNDARY, overlay edges on the BACK side of the mesh are occluded by the front faces — only edges on the front-facing surface are visible.
2. No z-fighting between lines and faces (lines draw cleanly on top of the faces they sit on).
3. Wireframe mode (Shift-something, separate feature) still draws through as today — no regression there.
testing-plan:
1. Load skull in live viewer, Shift+P to STAGES. Orbit to a side view — back-of-skull edges should not be visible through the cranium.
2. Switch to CREST_VS_BOUNDARY — same check.
3. Compare against current (depth-test-off) behavior to confirm the change only affects overlay modes.
